entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 5724, Standbuch 1012 fol. 446r; citing Liber 4 contractuum Rudolfi f. 31
entries.german:
Quitantz der von Rosenberg vber iii1/2 m fl am doten michaels 1487 Recepta 4 contractum Rudolfi fo 31.

Kontext: Fries' database comment says this entry is related to the preceding entries.
entries.english: Receipt issued by the von Rosenberg family documenting a sum written as “iii1/2 m fl” on the Feast of St Michael in 1487. The database summary gives 350,000 florins, while the excerpt's notation appears to mean 3,500. Fries' database comment says this entry is related to the preceding entries. Recorded in Liber 4 contractuum Rudolfi, folio 31.
facts: The von Rosenberg family issued a receipt recorded as “iii1/2 m fl” on 29 September 1487.
